did_you_know.premium_required_text: Upgrade to unlock more daily refreshes.
did_you_know.month_msg_1: ✨ January is a fresh start — the perfect time to welcome curiosity into your heart!
did_you_know.month_msg_2: 💫 February brings joy, color, and small discoveries that warm the heart.
did_you_know.month_msg_3: 🌿 March invites growth — a chance to learn and be enchanted by the world around you.
did_you_know.month_msg_4: 🌸 April awakens creativity — get ready for curious facts full of life!
did_you_know.month_msg_5: 🌼 May feels soft and inspiring — perfect for discovering something that makes you smile.
did_you_know.month_msg_6: 🌞 June comes with good energy and fascinating stories waiting for you!
did_you_know.month_msg_7: 🌻 July is the month of surprises — dive into these curiosities and be inspired.
did_you_know.month_msg_8: 🌺 August invites reflection and the discovery of new and unexpected things.
did_you_know.month_msg_9: 🍂 September brings inspiration — small curiosities to help you see the world through new eyes.
did_you_know.month_msg_10: 🌕 October carries mystery and magic — perfect for exploring the unknown!
did_you_know.month_msg_11: 🍁 November is a reminder: it's never too late to learn something new.
did_you_know.month_msg_12: 🎇 December closes the year with sparkle — curiosities to end with joy and lightness.
